visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a grey sweatshirt and a black baseball cap stands beside a woman with blonde-highlighted hair wearing a pink puffer vest over a white top. They are in a brightly lit indoor space, looking directly at the camera with joyful expressions. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a white, modern building featuring a prominent red Uniqlo logo. The woman stands in front of the entrance, smiling and gesturing towards the store under a clear blue sky with light clouds. (3) A close-up shows a red promotional banner inside the store with white and black text advertising a "Thank You Festival" with specific dates. The store environment behind it is brightly lit and filled with organized merchandise. (4) The couple is seen inside a large retail space with high ceilings and rows of hanging clothes. The man talks enthusiastically while the woman smiles next to him, surrounded by racks of colorful apparel. (5) A series of close-ups feature various clothing items including tank tops, thermal shirts, and jackets on display. Hand-drawn circles or hands point to price tags showing discounts. The lighting is bright and even across all products. (6) The man holds up a black long-sleeve shirt to show its texture and lack of branding. The woman is seen holding a red product box in front of her face, then looking through racks of white and beige shirts on hangers. (7) At a self-checkout station, the woman places several folded garments into a large white bin. A digital screen nearby displays transaction details while she gestures with her hands, explaining the process in a well-lit checkout area. (8) The final scene shows the woman walking outside on a paved path next to the white store building. She is happily carrying a large stack of shopping bags and boxes, smiling at the camera in the natural daylight.

(3) [Slogan]: 15th ANNIVERSARY UNIQLO 感謝祭 THANK YOU FESTIVAL 11.28 - 12.04. (4) [Subtitle]: 它的活動時間是11/28-12/4 今天是第一天. (5) [Slogan]: 新價格 NT$490. (6) [Subtitle]: 這個有特價啊 這邊有女生的背心 有490跟390的. (7) [Slogan]: 新價格 NT$390. (8) [Slogan]: HEATTECH 讓人溫暖的科技 限定商品 NT$590. (9) [Subtitle]: 極暖的發熱衣590而已耶. (10) [Subtitle]: 史努比的T恤才190耶. [Slogan]: NT$190. (11) [Subtitle]: 羽絨外套990. [Slogan]: 限定商品 NT$990. (30) [Subtitle]: 很久沒有遇到這麼好的店員了. (31) [Subtitle]: 好啦 我們買好囉 回家啦.

A male voice with a clear, energetic tone starts narrating in Mandarin, speaking at a fast pace with high pitch variability. (2) The BGM continues at a consistent volume as the male narrator describes the store location and dates of the sale. His voice remains enthusiastic and authoritative. A female voice briefly chimes in with a cheerful, high-pitched agreement, adding to the lively atmosphere. (3) As the narration covers different products, the speech rate remains high. Short, percussive sounds of clothing being handled and the subtle mechanical clicks of a self-checkout machine are audible under the continuous music bed. The ambient noise floor is low, suggesting a clean recording environment. (4) The narration concludes with the male and female voices speaking together in a celebratory tone. The music swells slightly before fading out as they announce their departure. The overall audio mix is professional, with clear vocal separation and a prominent, rhythmic background track throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog to inform viewers about the Uniqlo 'Thank You Festival' at the new Taoyuan Qingpu store. It aims to drive foot traffic by highlighting specific discounted items, limited-time offers, and the overall shopping convenience, such as self-checkout and proximity to IKEA.
